edges.reason: msg.sender is the mintDog caller, pays msg.value and is the recipient of the minted tokens.
mintDog compares block.timestamp to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide whether to set startingIndexBlock (timestamp dependency).
withdraw sends the whole contract balance to msg.sender and is guarded by onlyOwner.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender() (i.e. msg.sender) to authorize privileged functions.
setStartingIndex is publicly callable, so msg.sender can choose the call timing that determines which blockhash seeds the reveal.
msg.sender is passed as the 'to' argument of _safeMint in mintDog.
transferFrom authorizes msg.sender through _isApprovedOrOwner before moving the token.
safeTransferFrom authorizes msg.sender through _isApprovedOrOwner before moving the token.
msg.sender is the beneficiary of the ETH transfer performed by withdraw.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
withdraw is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which calls owner().
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is protected by onlyOwner.
flipSaleState is protected by onlyOwner.
setRevealTimestamp is protected by onlyOwner.
setProvenanceHash is protected by onlyOwner.
setBaseURI is protected by onlyOwner.
setTokenURI is protected by onlyOwner.
withdraw copies address(this).balance into the local variable balance.
withdraw executes the external ETH transfer to msg.sender.
mintDog reads saleIsActive as a precondition.
mintDog reads MAX_DOGS for the supply-cap check.
mintDog reads dogPrice to validate the sent Ether.
mintDog reads REVEAL_TIMESTAMP when deciding to set startingIndexBlock.
mintDog writes startingIndexBlock = block.number.
mintDog calls _safeMint inside the mint loop.
mintDog uses the loop counter i.
mintDog computes mintIndex from totalSupply().
mintIndex.add(1) is passed as the tokenId argument of _safeMint.
numberOfTokens controls the mint loop and payment/supply checks in mintDog.
_safeMint calls _mint to create the token.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received, which performs an external call.
_checkOnERC721Received issues the external onERC721Received callback to the receiver contract.
A malicious ERC721Receiver can reenter mintDog while the mint callback is executing.
A malicious receiver can reenter _safeMint through the receiver callback.
safeTransferFrom reaches _checkOnERC721Received via _safeTransfer, exposing the external callback.
transferFrom delegates the ownership update to _transfer.
safeTransferFrom delegates the ownership update to _transfer via _safeTransfer.
_mint adds tokenId to _holderTokens[to].
_mint sets _tokenOwners[tokenId] = to.
_transfer removes and adds tokenIds in _holderTokens.
_transfer updates _tokenOwners with the new owner.
_transfer clears the previous approval in _tokenApprovals.
setStartingIndex derives startingIndex from blockhash, a weak and caller-influenceable randomness source.
setStartingIndex requires startingIndexBlock != 0 before deriving the index.
setStartingIndex uses MAX_DOGS as the modulus for the derived index.
setStartingIndex relies on blockhash pseudo-randomness, which the caller can bias by timing the call.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock = block.number.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock requires startingIndex == 0.
flipSaleState toggles saleIsActive.
setRevealTimestamp writes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
setProvenanceHash writes HOUND_PROVENANCE.
The constructor sets MAX_DOGS from maxNftSupply.
The constructor sets REVEAL_TIMESTAMP = saleStart + 1.
revealTimeStamp parameter is assigned to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
provenanceHash parameter is assigned to HOUND_PROVENANCE.
baseURI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
tokenId parameter selects the token whose URI is set.
_tokenURI parameter is stored via _setTokenURI.
name parameter initializes the ERC721 token name.
symbol parameter initializes the ERC721 token symbol.
maxNftSupply parameter becomes MAX_DOGS.
saleStart parameter is used to compute REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
from parameter identifies the current owner in transferFrom.
to parameter is the recipient in transferFrom.
tokenId parameter selects the token transferred by transferFrom.
